notes.title: New visual identity
notes.content:
[p]Last few days I've been working on a new visual identity for this game to not be so bland. It's not yet in its final form, but you can try it out on branch [i]v0.8[/i] and let me know what you think.
Here's a little comparison:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593233/52fea5f18647dd5a3d4a0c4c70dc56a1f273f523.png"][/img][/p][p]Also last week, I together with few of my friends took part in the GMTK game jam. We tried our luck again with Godot engine (we used it for the first time in a previous smaller [url="https://gregstr.itch.io/project-asbestos"]game jam[/url] almost a year ago). Our final game wasn't much, but we might continue its development, you can check it out here if you're interested: [url="https://gregstr.itch.io/coup-detat"]https://gregstr.itch.io/coup-detat[/url][/p]

notes.title: Achievement and Graphical issues fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer achievement [i]Best birb far and wide[/i] should now be achievable.
[*] Fixed model graphical issues in Factory map (inverted meshes, sadly not big performance upgrade yet).
[/list]

notes.title: Small fix for Leader Board time formatting
notes.content: Fixed in game leader board time formatting and added new achievement for winning a multiplayer round

notes.title: Small fix for leader board submissions
notes.content: New leader board submissions for the steam community leader boards should now show the proper format

notes.title: Release the Birbs
notes.content: [p]You can now race in a new [b]Factory[/b] map that is not available in the demo[/p][p][/p][p]Full release has it's own scoreboards, so if you played the demo, your time is not carried over to the full game[/p][p][/p][p]Remember that this is just an early access release and a lot of stuff is going to change and be added. My plans are big, but I am just a single person developing in my free time, so it will take some time. [/p][p]Hope you can enjoy this release and set some nice times in the new map.[/p][p][/p][p]If you come across any bugs or problems, let me know on the Steam Community or on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/gregstr.eu"]Bluesky[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for supporting this endeavour.[/p]

notes.title: Bilingual
notes.content: [p]Last time I mentioned my fight with localization, I've now won and here are the fruits of my labor. I am ready for translations, right now I've translated everything to Czech, but that's about it with my abilities. You can help with translations and add languages you would be able to translate to[/p][p]You can change the language in the Game settings[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593233/0da08993012b4b4b2ed8e56bd89fbc38b94e3794.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593233/2ed242dfb3af1eb35aaab6182eff162691872d2f.png"][/img][/p][p] Help translate: [url="https://crowdin.com/project/birbgame/invite?h=a831b28a87a320bc632fd664b0c1c9b82464660"]https://crowdin.com/project/birbgame/invite?h=a831b28a87a320bc632fd664b0c1c9b82464660[/url][/p][p]I will be eternally grateful and you will be mentioned in the game's credits. Also I will try to make your translations process as smooth as possible, but there might be some bumps on the road there.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Small patches and what's coming next
notes.content: [h2]Small fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]added time submission even in multiplayer matches[/p][/*][*][p]Changed leader board dismissal to require a specific button press for controller and keyboard instead of any input (when using a mouse, you can click anywhere other than the leaderboard to dismiss it)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Bigger things I've been working on:[/h2][p]For quite some time now I've been building a new map for the birds to fly through, with more intricate maneuvers and more detailed environment. The progress has been quite slow lately, but now that I've graduated high school the progress might get quicker, there is a still a lot of optimizations to do to ensure the best performance, but here's a little sneak peek.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593233/3f3c8b01bd53dcebdb5f72c8fe09480f45f5730e.png"][/img][/p][p]I've also been chipping away on localizing the whole game, which I thought couldn't be too hard, because the game doesn't have much text, but I've been successfully fighting with all the localization tools to possibly make the translation efforts more community driven, because the most I can offer for languages other than English and Czech is machine translation right now.[/p]

notes.title: Fixed multiplayer issues and added a leaderboard
notes.content:
I've came across a problem where players cannot join using the code, because sometimes the host's game doesn't properly set the lobby code, this issue should now be fixed and not a problem anymore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593233/955016afa2a4acab4dc4b0d1982be04cc8af0a27.png[/img]

I've also added a very basic leader board that gets shown in the lobby when you finish a race. It's in a testing phase right now, but should be fully functional.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593233/07d881c75ad13c86e840a2500624d9adb8cce3d2.png[/img]

notes.title: Controller compatibility
notes.content:
[h1]Controller support[/h1]
Updated Birb Game so that all the menus are now fully navigable with just a controller (or just a keyboard or just a mouse).

Biggest visible change is the new lobby code input, instead of a text field there are now individual number selectors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593233/955016afa2a4acab4dc4b0d1982be04cc8af0a27.png[/img]

[h3]Minor updates[/h3]
Added option to dive with a middle mouse button, so that players are able to play with just a mouse.

In case of any bugs or feedback, let me know on the steam community forums, or on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/gregstr.eu]Bluesky[/url], or [url=https://x.com/game_birb]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Demo released
notes.content:
[h1]The Birb Game demo has just been released[/h1]

I will be updating this demo pretty heavily, most likely in the next few days for you to enjoy it to the fullest, but at some point, I will cut off this demo of new features to fully focus on the full game that will release into early access later this year.

I hope you will enjoy this demo, either with friends or just solo, share your thoughts and feelings about it in the community hub or @ me on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/gregstr.eu]blueksy[/url] or [url=https://x.com/game_birb]twitter[/url]
